findings.evidence: gateway.py:585-592 emits this label together with tunnel_disabled.detail, which now says 'en Radient Console'. In Spanish dev usage 'consola' commonly means the terminal/shell, so a bare 'la consola' in a CLI status line can read as 'turned off in the terminal'; English has the same ambiguity but weaker. Generic reference is grammatical and not wrong.
